papers.title: Decellularized extracellular matrix: a step towards the next generation source for bioink manufacturing.
papers.abstract: In tissue engineering, the need for hierarchical assembly of three-dimensional (3D) tissues has become increasingly important, considering that new technology is essential for advanced tissue fabrication. 3D cell printing has emerged as a powerful technology to recapitulate the microenvironment of native tissue, allowing for the precise deposition of multiple cells onto the pre-defined position. Parallel to these technological advances, the search for an appropriate bioink that can provide a suitable microenvironment supporting cellular activities has been in the spotlight. In this respect, the decellularized extracellular matrix (dECM) becomes a popular candidate as a well-qualified source of bioink because of its capability to inherit the intrinsic cues from a native ECM. Yet, few studies have been reported and its potential has been partially understood in the field of 3D cell printing. In this review, our focus is on a dECM as a prospective bioink to facilitate 3D cell printing-based tissue engineering. We begin this review with a brief description of the important role of the ECM. Next, the representative methods of decellularization and conventional applications of a dECM are introduced, followed by the recent achievements in dECM bioinks and their future directions.
papers.first_author_affiliation: Department of Mechanical Engineering, Pohang University of Science and Technology, Republic of Korea.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文是一篇关于脱细胞外基质作为生物墨水材料的综述，未涉及任何AI技术或生物打印中的智能控制。
llm.why_not_core: This paper is a review on decellularized extracellular matrix as a bioink source, with no mention of AI, machine learning, or any computational method for bioprinting process optimization or automation.

summary_zh.motivation: 寻找适合3D细胞打印的生物墨水，脱细胞外基质因保留天然ECM信号而成为候选。
summary_zh.method: 综述脱细胞化方法、dECM传统应用及作为生物墨水的最新进展。
summary_zh.result: dECM生物墨水具有提供细胞微环境的潜力，但研究仍有限，未来需优化。
summary_zh.validation: 未涉及实验验证，为文献综述。

summary_en.motivation: To identify a suitable bioink for 3D cell printing, decellularized extracellular matrix (dECM) is considered due to its ability to retain native ECM cues.
summary_en.method: This review summarizes decellularization methods, conventional applications of dECM, and recent advances in dECM-based bioinks.
summary_en.result: dECM bioinks show promise in providing a native-like microenvironment for cells, though research is still limited and future optimization is needed.
summary_en.validation: No experimental validation; this is a literature review.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究镍基高温合金的热机械性能，与生物医学AM方向中多孔结构、应力遮挡、骨整合等完全不相关。
llm.why_not_core: This paper focuses on nickel superalloys for high-temperature applications, not on biomedical implant materials, porous structures, stress shielding, or osseointegration relevant to orthopedic implants.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究镍基高温合金在热机械循环下的性能退化。
summary_zh.method: 采用选区激光熔化制备试样并进行阶梯式热机械测试。
summary_zh.result: 揭示了热机械加载对材料微观结构和力学性能的影响。
summary_zh.validation: 通过实验测试验证了热机械性能变化。

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the degradation of nickel superalloys under thermomechanical cycling for high-temperature applications.
summary_en.method: Specimens were fabricated by selective laser melting and subjected to staged thermomechanical testing.
summary_en.result: The study revealed the effect of thermomechanical loading on microstructure and mechanical properties.
summary_en.validation: Experimental testing validated the changes in thermomechanical performance.
